cbc.what_it_measures: Measures red blood cells, white blood cells, hemoglobin, hematocrit, and platelets to evaluate overall health and screen for conditions like anemia, infection, and clotting disorders.
cbc.why_ordered: Ordered as part of routine checkups, to investigate fatigue or fever, or to monitor blood conditions.
preparation: No special fasting required unless drawn with a metabolic panel.

cmp.what_it_measures: Evaluates 14 blood components including glucose, calcium, electrolytes (sodium, potassium, chloride, CO2), kidney function (BUN, creatinine), and liver enzymes (ALT, AST, ALP, bilirubin).
cmp.why_ordered: Assesses kidney and liver function, electrolyte balance, and blood sugar levels.
preparation: Fasting for 8-12 hours before the blood draw may be required.

lipid_panel.what_it_measures: Measures total cholesterol, LDL ('bad' cholesterol), HDL ('good' cholesterol), and triglycerides in your blood.
lipid_panel.why_ordered: Evaluates cardiovascular risk and monitors response to dietary changes or statin therapy.
preparation: Fasting for 9-12 hours is recommended for accurate triglyceride measurement.

hba1c.what_it_measures: Reflects your average blood sugar (glucose) levels over the past 2 to 3 months by measuring glycated hemoglobin.
hba1c.why_ordered: Used to diagnose prediabetes and diabetes, and to monitor blood sugar control in diabetic patients.
preparation: No fasting required; test can be performed at any time of day.

tsh.what_it_measures: Measures TSH produced by the pituitary gland to regulate thyroid hormone production.
tsh.why_ordered: Screens for hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid) or hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid).
preparation: Inform your doctor if taking thyroid medication or biotin supplements.
